Name: Bubble Totem
Author: Poplinp
Description:
[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b]
A new totem-type item that spawns fishing bubbles in bodies of water. Optimize your fishing setup to the max, or perhaps get a dopamine boost :))
[list]
[*]Cute & animated sprite (configurable)[/*]
[*]Configurable duration[/*]
[*]Bubbles spawn in the [b]direction the farmer is facing[/b], a set number of tiles in away from them. see "Max Distance of Bubbles" in config options.[/*]
[*]Bubbles spawned by the totem [b]override any existing bubbles in the location[/b] used, both vanilla and made by the totem, including vanilla fish frenzies. No new bubble spots would spawn there while the custom ones are active. There cannot be multiple sets of bubble spots simultaneously at the same location. [/*]
[*]i18n support[/*]
[/list]
[color=#6fa8dc][b][size=4]Obtain In-Game[/size][/b][/color]
Obtained via crafting. The crafting recipe is received at fishing level 8.
[u]Recipe details:[/u]
[spoiler]1 Hardwood
1 Joja Cola
5 Deluxe Bait

[size=2](yes, the Joja Cola is there because it is fizzy and I remembered have free will)[/size][/spoiler]


[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size][/color]
I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to edit the config file.

[left][font=Courier New][u][color=#ffffff][size=3]Duration of Bubbles[/size][/color][/u] [/font][/left]
How long should the bubbles stay after spawning, using in-game minutes. 
[b]default:[/b] 180 mins (3 in-game hours).

[size=3][u][font=Courier New]Max Distance of Bubbles[/font][/u][/size]
How many tiles away from the farmer should the bubbles try to spawn. This distance can affect the type and quality of the fish caught. If the set distance is too long for a specific spot, the bubbles would try to spawn closer. 
[b]default:[/b] 6 tiles (max casting length at fishing levels 8-14).

[size=3][font=Courier New][u]Animated Totem[/u][/font][/size][size=3] [/size]
whether the totem item is animated or still. If ticked, the sprite would have animated bubbles blowing (see images), appearing in menus and while being held. 
[b]default:[/b] true.


[b][color=#6fa8dc][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]
 Possibly incompatible with mods impacting bubble spot mechanics. Description would be updated to reflect known incompatibilities if encountered.
